voice.input_audio: 24 kHz audio (WAV or WebAudio) through the Mimi codec of Moshi; a text prompt and a voice prompt are given before the conversation starts [nvidia-card-personaplex]
voice.output_audio: 24 kHz audio (WAV or WebAudio), with the agent's text [nvidia-card-personaplex]
voice.voices: 18 packaged voice prompts: 8 natural (NATF0 to NATF3 female, NATM0 to NATM3 male) and 10 varied (VARF0 to VARF4, VARM0 to VARM4); a voice prompt of audio tokens sets the voice and speaking style [nvidia-gh-personaplex] [nvidia-card-personaplex]
voice.turn_detection: None to configure; the model runs two parallel streams, listening and speaking at once, and decides itself when to speak [nvidia-card-personaplex]
voice.interruption: Built into the model, which handles interruptions, barge-ins, overlaps and rapid turn-taking; no setting exists [nvidia-card-personaplex]
voice.latency: NVIDIA, Full-Duplex-Bench: 0.170 seconds smooth turn-taking latency and 0.240 seconds for the agent to stop after a user interruption, on an A100 80 GB [nvidia-card-personaplex]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights with no hosted price. The repository says a GPU is needed (tested on an A100 80 GB; Ampere and Hopper listed), with a CPU-offload option for small GPUs [nvidia-gh-personaplex] [nvidia-card-personaplex]
